items.note: Cabin bag. Get the 12 V 30 kg model (the sim uses its limits), not the 7.4 V 19 kg one. UK price to check on the page. Bulk on Alibaba ~$10.60 at 1,000+.

items.item: Servo driver board (Waveshare Bus Servo Adapter A)
items.note: Cabin bag. Drives ST-series bus servos over USB. It passes the supply voltage straight to the servos.
Cabin bag. Match the driver board's USB port.
Cabin bag. Must be 12 V to match the 12 V servos, with a 100–240 V input so it works in Brazil (127 V and 220 V). Size the amps for six servos.
GTMax3D is an authorised Bambu Lab reseller in Brazil. Other shops: bambulab.com/pt-br/where-to-buy. Pending a chat with Mum.
